request.system:
Decide whether a sentence is fully supported by the quoted source texts and computed values given. Supported means
every claim in the sentence is stated in a quote or equals a provided computed value. Wording can differ; meaning
cannot. Anything extra, stronger, or interpretive is unsupported. Return only the tool call.
request.user:
SENTENCE: RPO grew 0.4483 year over year while trailing revenue grew 0.2410, and the trailing operating margin is 0.1650.
QUOTES: []
COMPUTED: ["m:rpo_yoy: {\"description\": \"RPO vs a year earlier\", \"unit\": \"ratio\", \"value\": \"0.4483\"}", "m:revenue_ttm_yoy: {\"description\": \"TTM revenue vs the TTM a year earlier\", \"unit\": \"ratio\", \"value\": \"0.2410\"}", "m:op_margin_ttm: {\"description\": \"TTM operating income / TTM revenue\", \"unit\": \"ratio\", \"value\": \"0.1650\"}"]

content.reason: All three figures match the computed values: RPO vs a year earlier = 0.4483, TTM revenue vs prior year = 0.2410, and TTM operating margin = 0.1650. No quotes were provided, but every claim equals a provided computed value.
